text:
```yaml
name: Compile Time Tracker

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  compile-time-tracker:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.8'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install -r requirements.txt

    - name: Run compile time tracker script
      run: |
        python scripts/compile_time_tracker.py
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/compile-time-tracker.yaml` is designed to run a script named `compile_time_tracker.py` whenever there is a push or pull request to the `main` branch of the `tenstorrent/tt-metal` repository. The script is expected to track and report on any changes in compile times, helping maintain performance standards as the codebase evolves.
